zero_cost_boundary.plan_b_and_c: prepared historically but not automatically authorized by this package

nodes: FAE_PEERS with two stable peer bootstrap URLs
stable identity via existing FAE_IDENTITY_FILE or FAE_NODE_IDENTITY_JSON_B64
required_runtime_inputs.secret_policy: No wallet seed/private key is required or admitted. Existing node identity material remains provider-managed configuration. FAE_V3_MINER_ADDRESS is public-only.

launch_procedure: At or after the 2026-10-01 checkpoint, read-only recheck Render workspace and the five required service records.
Fail closed unless every required service remains plan=free, unsuspended, auto-deploy off, and the free-hour proof establishes >=540 remaining hours for the 108h envelope.
Verify render-wan-lab resolves exactly to ef8f6ca3838abf6ef0e882c10a31bc70a2ae6e9d; do not deploy a different revision.
Bring the five existing free services to the tested revision with FAE_V3_RUN_ID set and NO FAE_V3_T0_UTC yet. This is prestart only.

Verify /v3/health and /v3/meta on all three nodes plus controller and observer; confirm distinct stable node identities, >=2 configured peers per node, exact revision, no run_started flag, and a common healthy chain view.
Run the frozen prestart contract and persist its evidence. Record initial height and a public-only FAE_V3_MINER_ADDRESS.

Arm controller and observer with one identical future FAE_V3_T0_UTC, controller FAE_V3_START_HEIGHT, and the public miner address. Ensure both monitors boot healthy before T0. Do not alter code/config after T0.
Treat the run as started only at T0 with persisted launch evidence. Partial prestart/arming is not a started soak.
During 96h preserve dual monitor coverage, node-local telemetry, 180s recovery bound, stale/reorg accounting, propagation samples, checkpoints and provider logs without changing criteria.
At >=96 continuous hours, capture controller/observer/node event streams, /v3/chain-summary, exact revision metadata and provider runtime evidence before any cleanup.
Run evidence admission and the frozen analyzer/classifier. Only PASS closes the soak; any partial or missing evidence uses the frozen terminal classifications.
After evidence capture/admission, stop the lab-only runtime using non-destructive provider controls and retain all admitted artifacts.

checkpoint_recovery.state_write: Durable state plus atomic raw-state replacement in authoritative recovery path
checkpoint_recovery.restart_semantics: Node identity/bootstrap configuration survives runtime replacement; ephemeral chain state may be rebuilt from peers and is measured against the 180s bound.

raw: Render application logs for controller, observer and nodes
frozen: FAE-testnet branch artifacts bound to exact commit
evidence_destinations.retention_guard: Export/admit raw provider evidence before provider log retention can expire; absence of required evidence => EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.

wake_condition.exact_condition: At/after checkpoint: Render workspace unsuspended AND five required services still free AND >=540 free instance-hours independently proven AND exact revision/prestart health gates GREEN.
wake_condition.if_unsatisfied: Remain CONDITION_WAIT. Do not use paid fallback and do not declare V3 started.
